page.notes: The first word of the page is read as "queamus" from the scan; the start is a fragment and stays so. "Iinamus" is doubtful, marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so "fatis" is read as "satis" and "fi" as "si"; these readings are inferred from the long-s form and are uncertain. The "conse-" catchword shares its line with the signature "I 5" and is read as "conse-" with some doubt. No marginal notes are printed on this page. Small marks and fragments at the right and left edges are not transcribed.
